newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 17.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 17.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:

** Indonesia's current cement shortage was likely to continue in the coming years, but an oversupply was likely in 2003 if all 32 firms given permits to build cement firms go ahead with their plans, Indonesian cement association says.
** The Dow index of 30 blue chips rose 16.03 points to close at 6,020.81, its 29th record this year on Wednesday as investors sought the safety of big companies more likely to deliver solid earnings.
** The Jakarta Composite Index fell 2.81 points, or 0.49 percent, to close at 565.78 points on Wednesday as falls in some blue-chips were coupled with local-led profit-taking in secondaries.
** On Thursday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,323.80/24.00 in early trading against an opening of 2,323.00/24.00.

** Astra on reports that Mohamad Hasan, a high ranking official with the Nusamba Group, consisting of foundations controlled by President Suharto, was not interested to buying the automobile firm's shares if the price was too high.
** Concord Benefit Enterprise on reports Concord, which core businees is garment manufacturing, had won a tender to build toll road in West Java.
** Garment maker Karwell on reports it had secured a licence to produce and sell garments using Walt Disney's trade mark "Pooh."
** Rig Tenders on talk the shipping firm was likely to be acquired by a foreign firm. Rig had denied the rumours on Tuesday.
